arxiv-2108-06221.title: Key parameters for surface plasma wave excitation in the ultra-high intensity regime
arxiv-2108-06221.creator: S. Marini, P. S. Kleij, F. Amiranoff, M. Grech, C. Riconda, M. Raynaud
arxiv-2108-06221.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by S. Marini, P. S. Kleij, F. Amiranoff, M. Grech, C. Riconda, M. Raynaud. Ultra-short high-power lasers can deliver extreme light intensities ( ≥ 10 20 \geq 10^{20} W/cm 2 and ≤ 30 ​ f \leq 30f s) and drive large amplitude Surface Plasma Wave (SPW) at over-dense plasma surface. The resulting current of energetic electron has great interest for applications, potentially scaling with the laser amplitude, provided the laser-plasma transfer to the accelerated particles mediated by SPW is still efficient at ultra high intensity.

arxiv-2109-10164.title: RAIL-KD: RAndom Intermediate Layer Mapping for Knowledge Distillation
arxiv-2109-10164.creator: Md Akmal Haidar Nithin Anchuri Mehdi Rezagholizadeh, Abbas Ghaddar Philippe Langlais Pascal Poupart
arxiv-2109-10164.description: Abstract Intermediate layer knowledge distillation (KD) can improve the standard KD technique (which only targets the output of teacher and student models) especially over large pre-trained language models. However, intermediate layer distillation suffers from excessive computational burdens and engineering efforts required for setting up a proper layer mapping.

arxiv-2206-02026.title: Fast, Stable and Efficient Approximation of Multi-parameter Persistence Modules with MMA
arxiv-2206-02026.creator: David Loiseaux, Mathieu Carrière, Andrew J. Blumberg
arxiv-2206-02026.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by David Loiseaux, Mathieu Carrière, Andrew J. Blumberg. Topological data analysis (TDA) is a rapidly growing area of data science which uses the geometry and topology of data sets to produce qualitative multi-scale shape descriptors for subsequent statistical and machine learning tasks. The most common descriptor in TDA is persistent homology, which tracks the topological changes in growing families of subsets of the data set itself, called filtrations, and encodes them in an algebraic object, called a persistence module.

arxiv-2207-02962.title: Imprints of flavor anomalies on neutrino oscillations through dark matter halo
arxiv-2207-02962.creator: Ashutosh Kumar Alok, Neetu Raj Singh Chundawat, Arindam Mandal
arxiv-2207-02962.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ashutosh Kumar Alok, Neetu Raj Singh Chundawat, Arindam Mandal. In this work we study the impact of new physics, stimulated by flavor anomalies, on neutrino oscillations through dense dark matter halo. arxiv-2305-15059.title: Decidability of Difference Logic over the Reals with Uninterpreted Unary Predicates
arxiv-2305-15059.creator: Bernard Boigelot, Pascal Fontaine, Baptiste Vergain
arxiv-2305-15059.description: Abstract First-order logic fragments mixing quantifiers, arithmetic, and uninterpreted predicates are often undecidable, as is, for instance, Presburger arithmetic extended with a single uninterpreted unary predicate. In the SMT world, difference logic is a quite popular fragment of linear arithmetic which is less expressive than Presburger arithmetic.

arxiv-2308-15124.title: Characterising Trees and Hyperbolic Spaces by their Boundaries
arxiv-2308-15124.creator: Isobel Davies
arxiv-2308-15124.description: Abstract . We use the language of proper CAT(-1) spaces to study thick, locally compact trees, the real, complex and quaternionic hyperbolic spaces and the hyperbolic plane over the octonions. These are rank 1 Euclidean buildings, respectively rank 1 symmetric spaces of non-compact type.

arxiv-2407-17449.title: Looking at Model Debiasing through the Lens of Anomaly Detection
arxiv-2407-17449.creator: Vito Paolo Pastore, Massimiliano Ciranni, Davide Marinelli, Francesca Odone, Vittorio Murino
arxiv-2407-17449.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Vito Paolo Pastore, Massimiliano Ciranni, Davide Marinelli, Francesca Odone, Vittorio Murino. Deep neural networks are likely to learn unintended spurious correlations between training data and labels when dealing with biased data, potentially limiting the generalization to unseen samples not presenting the same bias. In this context, model debiasing approaches can be devised aiming at reducing the model’s dependency on such unwanted correlations, either leveraging the knowledge of bias information or not.

arxiv-2501-17925.creator: Rosa M. Mérida, Gaia Gaspar, Marcin Sawicki, Yoshihisa Asada, Guillaume Desprez, Gregor Rihtaršič, Jacqueline Antwi-Danso, Roberta Tripodi, Chris J. arxiv-2501-17925.description: Abstract We report the discovery of a z ∼ 7 z\sim 7 group of galaxies that contains two little red dots (LRDs) just 3.3 kpc apart, along with three potential satellite galaxies, as part of the Canadian NIRISS Unbiased Cluster Survey (CANUCS).

arxiv-2509-06369.title: Rickard’s derived Morita theory: Review and Outlook
arxiv-2509-06369.creator: Gustavo Jasso, Henning Krause, Sibylle Schroll
arxiv-2509-06369.description: Abstract . We survey the main results in Jeremy Rickard’s seminal papers ‘Morita theory for derived categories’ and ‘Derived equivalences and derived functors’. These papers catalysed the later development of the Morita theory of (enhanced) compactly generated triangulated categories by Keller in the algebraic setting and by Schwede and Shipley in the topological setting.

arxiv-2512-07753.title: Enumeration of maps with the Dumitriu-Edelman model
arxiv-2512-07753.creator: Thomas Buc–d’Alché
arxiv-2512-07753.description: Abstract We give an expansion in 1 / N 1/N and β \beta of the cumulants of power sums of the particles of the β \beta -ensemble. This new expansion is obtained using the tridiagonal model of Dumitriu and Edelman. The coefficients of the expansion are expressed in terms of suitably labelled maps introduced by Bouttier, Fusy, and Guitter.

pmc-10690687.description: Background and ObjectivesGranuloma annulare (GA) is a benign skin disorder with various histopathologic features that are rarely investigated in Iranian population. Clinical data and pathological features were recorded.

pmc-12698641.creator: Kamran Ashraf, Qamar uz Zaman, Weihua Tang, Pei Jiang, Xun Wan, Khitev Yuri, Ali Mohsin, Meijin Guo
pmc-12698641.description: Plant hormone-loaded nanoparticles (NPs) represent a novel class of materials with significant potential in plant cell culture, owing to their unique physico-chemical properties. The utilization of these hormone-loaded NPs as elicitors could enhance the production of bioactive compounds and boost antioxidant enzymatic activity in plant cell suspension cultures.

pmc-13220755.creator: Harold Pulido-Guarín, Ana Carolina Monmany-Garzia, Alejandra Carla Scannapieco, Andrés Felipe Ramírez-Mejía, Martín Geria, Alberto Galindo-Cardona, Juliana Rangel
pmc-13220755.description: The presence of magnetite in the abdomen of Apis mellifera suggests a role in magnetic signal perception, aiding orientation and navigation. Reproduction occurs in drone congregation areas (DCA), which are spatially and temporally stable, appearing in spring–summer during regionally specific mating flight times (midday to evening), when Earth’s magnetic field intensity (EMFI) often increases.

pmc-13308088.title: HMPV Impairs Macrophage Phagocytosis Through a Replication-Dependent Mechanism Associated with Reduced CD36 Expression and the Viral G Protein
pmc-13308088.creator: Iván Martínez-Espinoza, Pius I. Babawale, Basel Abuaita, Antonieta Guerrero-Plata
pmc-13308088.description: Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a major cause of respiratory infections, but its impact on macrophage antibacterial functions remains poorly understood. Macrophages play a crucial role in host defense through phagocytosis, and impairment of this function may increase susceptibility to secondary infections. Here, we show that HMPV infection of THP-1-derived macrophages significantly reduces bacterial uptake in a replication-dependent manner.

pmc-13447985.title: Patterns of psychopathology and personal strengths among youth in psychiatric care
pmc-13447985.creator: Logan R. Cummings, Gil Noam, Alessandro S. De Nadai, Kathryn Parker, Patricia Allen, Julianne G. Wilner, Jillian M. Russo, Lauren O. Delman, Aishwarya Surendran, Emily G. Arnott, Dawn E. Sugarman, Alisa Busch, Alexander Kos, Fairlee C. Fabrett, Ralph Buonopane, Kristen L. Batejan, Erika C. Esposito,
pmc-13447985.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe American Academy of Pediatrics and the American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry have declared a National State of Emergency in Children's Mental Health, calling for improved approaches to address youth mental health. We sought to leverage the first child psychiatry division‐wide measurement‐based care initiative to advance understanding of how both psychopathology and social‐emotional skills are related among youth patients, as these associations are rarely examined together.

pmc-13548767.title: Crystal structure, supra­molecular and Hirshfeld surface analysis of piperazine-1,4-diium bis­(2,5-di­bromo­benzoate)
pmc-13548767.creator: Veerappan Subha, Marimuthu Sathish, Thangavelu Balakrishnan
pmc-13548767.description: The crystal structure of piperazine-1,4-diium bis­(2,5-di­bromo­benzoate) is reported, with detailed analysis of its intra- and inter­molecular hydrogen-bonding inter­actions, supra­molecular architecture, and Hirshfeld surface analysis. Chemical context Piperazine is a six-membered heterocyclic aliphatic amine containing nitro­gen atoms at the 1 and 4 positions, resulting in a symmetrical structure.

pmc-13581269.title: Differences in Early Tacrolimus Exposure in Kidney Transplant Recipients With and Without CYP3A5 Genotype‐Guided Tacrolimus Dosing
pmc-13581269.creator: Amy L Pasternak, Jenna Schwartz, Brett Vanderwerff, Sebastian Zöllner, Danielle J Haakinson, Mona Doshi, Jeong M Park
pmc-13581269.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). CYP3A5 genotype is a known predictor of tacrolimus dose requirements. This single‐center retrospective study evaluated the impact of CYP3A5 genotype‐guided dosing, implemented at our institution in 10/2023, on early tacrolimus exposure. Patients were included if they were adult kidney transplant recipients between 7/2014 and 10/2024; patients in the weight‐based cohort had research CYP3A5 genotypes in the institutional research biorepository and the genotype‐guided cohort had a clinical CYP3A5 genotype available at transplant.

pmc-13611665.title: From Proteomic Signatures to Candidate Endotypes in Obesity, Type 2 Diabetes, MASLD/MASH, and MetALD: Study Designs, Bioinformatics, and Biostatistical Strategies
pmc-13611665.creator: Zhennan Wu, Sachin Anil Ghag, Md Hasan Imam Shihab, Aatman Pushkarkumar Vasoya, Vinamrata Sharma, Jacob Patton Hickman, Yijie Wang, Xiaoqing Huang, Menghao Huang
pmc-13611665.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Obesity, type 2 diabetes (T2D), metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), and dual-etiology metabolic dysfunction-associated alcohol-related liver disease (MetALD) form an overlapping metabolic dysfunction spectrum, rather than a single linear disease sequence. Proteomics offers a functional readout of this spectrum by measuring proteins, proteoforms, and protein species involved in tissue injury, inflammation, metabolic stress, and inter-organ communication. This review asks how proteomic data can support mechanism-based stratification, rather than simply generate disease-associated signatures.
